name: Harriet Collins
text: Eltoromia turned a damp, awkward slope into a terrace we use almost every evening. The team explained the drainage clearly and the finish around the brick planters is superb.

name: Daniel Mercer
text: The quotation was detailed, the site stayed tidy and the block paving has completely changed the front of the house. Neighbours have already asked who did it.

name: Priya Nair
text: We wanted a grown-up garden that still worked for children. Eltoromia created separate spaces without making it feel fussy. The planting is already settling in beautifully.

name: George Whitfield
text: Professional from survey to handover. The new slatted fencing is straight, strong and much smarter than the panels it replaced.

name: Nadia Brooks
text: The deck has made our kitchen extension feel complete. The subframe and ventilation were explained properly, which gave us confidence in the build.

name: Simon Avery
text: A very good experience. Weather delayed the jointing by a couple of days, but communication was excellent and the finished patio looks sharp.

name: Lena Foster
text: The new steps feel safe and look like they have always belonged to the house. Small details were handled with real care.

name: Mark Reynolds
text: Eltoromia helped us prioritise what mattered instead of selling us a full rebuild. The garden is cleaner, easier to use and much more inviting.
